A test that tells humans and computers apart, often by asking you to click on pictures or type distorted letters.
also: CAPTCHA farms
CAPTCHA solving technique
CAPTCHA solving is the process of getting past website tests that are meant to prove a visitor is human.
CAPTCHAs concept
CAPTCHAs are tests websites use to try to tell humans apart from automated bots.
capture concept
A capture is a part of a regular expression that saves matched text so it can be reused or referenced later.
Carnival Cruise Line organization
Carnival Cruise Line is a cruise-ship company.
also: Carnival
Castle organization
Castle is a security or fraud-prevention vendor referenced in security reporting.
CcProtect malware
CcProtect is a driver or malware-related component associated with disabling security software.
CcProtect.sys malware
CcProtect.sys is a Windows driver associated with security-software killing behavior when abused by attackers.
also: known original, original
CDATA protocol
CDATA is an XML section that marks text so it is treated as character data instead of XML markup.
cellular modems product
Cellular modems are devices that connect computers or equipment to the internet using mobile phone networks.
CEO concept
A CEO is the chief executive officer, the top executive responsible for leading an organization.
Cerebras REAP tool
Cerebras REAP is a model-analysis method or tool used to estimate the importance of AI-model components.
also: REAP, Router-weighted Expert Activation Pruning
Certificate Authority concept
A trusted organization or service that issues and signs digital certificates.
ChaCha20 protocol
ChaCha20 is an encryption algorithm used to scramble data so only someone with the right key can read it.
ChainScript malware
A remote-access trojan that can be installed on Windows devices to let attackers control them from a distance.
Channel concept
Channel is a communication path or grouping used to send messages, updates, or data between systems or people.
chatbots concept
A computer program that simulates human conversation to answer questions or perform tasks.
chatgpt
ChatGPT is OpenAI’s conversational AI assistant.
china
China is a country often referenced in cybersecurity reporting involving technology, espionage, regulation, and threat activity.
Chrome product
A popular web browser developed by Google, frequently targeted by exploit kits and phishing campaigns.
Chubb organization
Chubb is a global insurance company.
cisa organization
CISA is the U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency, which helps protect critical infrastructure and shares security guidance.
Cisco Identity Services Engine product
A Cisco network access-control product that helps organizations decide which users and devices may connect to a network.
Cisco ISE product
Cisco Identity Services Engine, a network access-control platform that manages who and what can connect to a network.
civilian concept
A person not in the armed services or law enforcement, who may be a target or collateral victim in cyber operations.
CJIS organization
CJIS is the FBI division and set of systems that support criminal-justice information sharing in the United States.
CJIS Security Policy concept
The CJIS Security Policy is an FBI policy that sets security requirements for systems handling criminal-justice information.
CL-STA-0240 threat-actor
CL-STA-0240 is a threat-actor tracking label used by cybersecurity researchers.
also: DeceptiveDevelopment, DEV#POPPER, Famous Chollima, Gwisin Gang
Cl0p malware
Cl0p is a ransomware family and criminal brand associated with attacks that encrypt or steal data to extort victims.
also: Cl0p ransomware gang, the ransomware group
Cl0p ransomware group threat-actor
The Cl0p ransomware group is a cybercriminal group known for stealing data and using ransomware or extortion against organizations.
classification concept
Classification is the act of sorting data, events, or systems into categories so they can be handled appropriately.
claude-code
Claude Code is Anthropic’s AI coding assistant for helping developers write and manage software projects.
Cleo organization
Cleo is a vendor of managed file-transfer software used by organizations to exchange files.
Click2Shell vulnerability
Click2Shell is the name given to a WordPress vulnerability that can trick an administrator's browser into installing a theme.
clickfix
ClickFix is a social-engineering tactic that tricks users into copying and running malicious commands to “fix” a fake problem.
ClickFix lures technique
ClickFix lures are social-engineering tricks that persuade users to copy and run commands by pretending to fix a computer or browser problem.
ClickFix scripts technique
ClickFix scripts are malicious web scripts that trick people into running attacker-provided commands by pretending to offer a fix or verification step.
ClickFix-style technique
A social-engineering technique that tricks people into running harmful commands by presenting them as a fix or verification step.
Clipboard Contents concept
Clipboard contents are the text, files, or other data a person has copied and may later paste.
clipboard data concept
Clipboard data is the text, images, or other content temporarily stored when a user copies or cuts something on a computer or phone.
Clipboard theft technique
Clipboard theft is when malicious software steals information a user has copied, such as passwords, payment details, or cryptocurrency wallet addresses.
cloud concept
The cloud is internet-based computing where data and applications run on remote servers instead of only on your own device.
cloud account concept
A cloud account is an account used to access and manage computing resources such as servers, storage, and databases from a cloud provider.
cloud configurations concept
Cloud configurations are the settings that control how cloud services, accounts, networks, and permissions behave.
cloud environments concept
Cloud environments are computing systems and services run in cloud platforms rather than on local machines.
Cloud First concept
A government technology strategy that encourages agencies to consider cloud-based services before traditional on-site systems.
cloud services concept
Computing resources—like storage, apps, and networking—delivered over the internet by providers such as AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.
cloud systems concept
Cloud systems are computer services and data storage run on internet-connected servers instead of only on a person's or company's own machines.
Cloud threat emulation technique
Cloud threat emulation safely recreates attacker actions in cloud systems to test security controls and detections.
also: cloud emulation, cloud threat emulation/detection engineering (TE/DE)
Cloudflare API key concept
A Cloudflare API key is a secret credential that lets software make authorized changes through Cloudflare's management interface.
CloudGoat tool
CloudGoat is an open-source tool that creates intentionally vulnerable AWS environments for cloud-security training.
CloudTrail product
CloudTrail is an AWS service that records management API activity.
CMK concept
A customer managed key is an encryption key that a customer controls in a cloud key-management service.
also: customer managed key
CnCrypt product
CnCrypt is a Chinese disk-encryption software product.
also: Chinese disk-encryption product CnCrypt
coach and pivot technique
A security approach that warns a user about risky behavior and directs them toward a safer approved option.
also: “coach and pivot” alerts
code execution technique
Code execution means an attacker can make a computer or server run commands or software of their choosing.
code repository tool
A code repository is an online or local storage place where software source code and its change history are kept.
Code Security Audit technique
A code security audit is a review of software code to find security weaknesses before attackers can exploit them.
coding concept
Coding is writing instructions in a programming language so a computer can perform tasks.
Coding agents tool
Coding agents are AI tools that can help write, edit, test, or reason about software code.
coding tests concept
Coding tests are programming exercises that employers may use to evaluate job applicants.
command execution technique
Command execution means making a computer or device run instructions, often through a shell or remote interface.
command prompt tool
A text-based window where a user types commands for the computer to run.
command-and-control concept
Command-and-control is the way attackers remotely send instructions to malware and receive data back from infected machines.
Command-and-Control Channels concept
Communication paths malware uses to receive instructions from and send information back to its operators.
command-and-control infrastructure concept
Command-and-control infrastructure is the servers and systems attackers use to send instructions to malware and receive stolen data.
command-and-control servers concept
Remote computers controlled by attackers that send orders to infected devices and collect stolen data.
Community Services concept
Community Services refers to healthcare or social support services delivered outside major hospital settings, often in local communities.
ComponentTask33 malware
A build name associated with the ChainScript malware family.
compression concept
Reducing the size of data or files to save storage or bandwidth, sometimes used to obfuscate malware.
compromise concept
A compromise is a situation where a system, account, or data has been breached or taken over by an attacker.
compromised concept
Compromised means a system, account, or device has been accessed or controlled by someone who should not have access.
compromised credentials concept
Compromised credentials are login details that have been stolen, exposed, or otherwise made unsafe.
compromised identity concept
A compromised identity is an account or digital identity that an attacker has taken control of or can use without permission.
Compromised Passwords concept
Compromised passwords are passwords that have been stolen, leaked, guessed, or otherwise exposed to attackers.
Compromised systems concept
Compromised systems are computers, servers, or devices that an attacker has successfully broken into or controlled.
Conditional Formatting concept
A spreadsheet feature that automatically changes a cell's appearance when its value meets chosen rules.
conditional-access
Conditional access is a security policy that allows or blocks logins based on risk, device, location, or other conditions.
also: Conditional Access policies
Configuration error vulnerability
A configuration error is a mistake in settings that can make a system behave incorrectly or become insecure.
confirmed breaches concept
Confirmed breaches are security incidents where unauthorized access or data exposure has been verified.
Confluence product
Confluence is Atlassian’s collaboration and documentation platform for teams.
Connecting concept
Connecting is a status meaning a device, app, or service is trying to establish a network connection.
Consent concept
A person's informed agreement to let an organization collect, use, or share their information.
consent judgment concept
A consent judgment is a court-approved settlement where parties agree to terms that become legally enforceable.
Consumer Rights Organizations organization
Consumer rights organizations are groups that advocate for people who buy or use products and services.
Contact Details concept
Information used to contact a person, such as an address, email address, or phone number.
Contact information concept
Contact information means details like an email address, phone number, or mailing address that can be used to reach someone.
Contagious Interview technique
Contagious Interview is a North Korea-linked campaign that tricks job seekers or developers into running malicious software during fake interviews.
container escape technique
A container escape is when an attacker breaks out of an isolated software container to access the underlying host system.
continuous concept
In security, continuous means something is monitored or updated all the time instead of only during occasional checks.
Continuous compliance concept
The practice of continuously collecting evidence that security and regulatory requirements are being met.
continuous monitoring concept
Continuous monitoring means constantly watching systems, accounts, or networks for problems or suspicious activity.
controllers concept
System components that manage or direct how other parts of an application or infrastructure behave.
Copilot product
Copilot is Microsoft's AI assistant built into various Microsoft products to help with tasks like writing, searching, and coding.
copilots product
Copilots are AI assistants built into software to help users write, search, summarize, or complete tasks.
copy and paste concept
A common computer action that duplicates selected content and places it somewhere else.
Copy-paste technique
Copy-paste is the everyday action of copying text or data from one place and inserting it somewhere else.
corporate network concept
A corporate network is the private collection of computers, servers, and systems used by an organization.
corporate networks concept
Corporate networks are the connected computers, servers, and systems used by a company.
Court order concept
A court order is an official instruction from a judge that requires someone to do or stop doing something.
Crafted link technique
A specially constructed web link intended to cause a program or person to perform an attacker-chosen action.
credential concept
A credential is proof of identity for logging in, such as a password, security token, API key, or certificate.
credential collection technique
The process of harvesting usernames, passwords, and tokens, typically by malware or phishing, to gain unauthorized access.
Credential compromise concept
Credential compromise means a password, token, or key has been stolen or exposed so someone unauthorized can log in.
credential exposure concept
Credential exposure means usernames, passwords, keys, or tokens have been revealed where attackers may be able to use them.
Credential Guard product
A Windows security feature that uses virtualization to protect sensitive credentials from theft.
credential rotation technique
Credential rotation means replacing passwords, keys, or tokens with new ones to reduce the risk from stolen or old credentials.
credential-stuffing technique
Credential stuffing is when attackers try stolen usernames and passwords on many websites to see where they still work.
credentials concept
Credentials are login details or access tokens that prove a user or system is allowed to access something.
critical severity concept
Critical severity means a security issue is considered very dangerous and should usually be fixed as quickly as possible.
critical vulnerabilities vulnerability
Critical vulnerabilities are very serious security flaws that could let attackers cause major damage or gain major access.
Critical vulnerability vulnerability
A critical vulnerability is a very serious security flaw that can cause major damage if exploited.
cross-site request forgery vulnerability
Cross-site request forgery is an attack that tricks a logged-in browser into sending an unwanted request to a website.
Cruciferra threat-actor
Cruciferra is a threat-actor or campaign name referenced in security reporting.
Cruciferra crypter tool
Cruciferra crypter is a paid tool used to package and hide malware from security analysis.
cryptocurrency concept
Cryptocurrency is digital money, such as Bitcoin, that uses cryptography and usually runs on a blockchain.
cryptocurrency exchanges organization
Cryptocurrency exchanges are online services where people buy, sell, or trade digital currencies like Bitcoin.

A cryptocurrency startup is a new business built around cryptocurrency or blockchain-related products and services.
cryptocurrency wallet product
A cryptocurrency wallet is software or hardware used to store and use the keys that control digital coins.
cryptocurrency wallet enumeration technique
A technique in which malware searches a device for installed cryptocurrency wallet applications or browser extensions.
Cryptocurrency Wallet Files concept
Files that may contain information needed to access or manage cryptocurrency funds.
cryptocurrency wallets product
Cryptocurrency wallets are tools used to store and manage access to digital currency funds.
Cryptographic results concept
Cryptographic results are the outputs of security calculations, such as encrypted data, digital signatures, or message checks.

CSRF is a web attack where a site is tricked into performing an action using a logged-in user's session without the user's intent.
Cumulative updates concept
Cumulative updates are software updates that include current fixes plus earlier fixes in one package.
cursor
Cursor is an AI-assisted code editor built for software developers.
Custom intelligence feeds concept
Custom intelligence feeds are tailored lists of security data, such as malicious IP addresses or domains, built for a specific organization or use case.

A custom stream cipher is a nonstandard method of encrypting data a little at a time, often used by malware to hide text.
customer identity concept
Customer identity is the information and login details that identify a customer in an application or service.
customer information concept
Customer information is data a business keeps about its customers, such as names, contact details, purchases, or account records.
Customer Records concept
Stored information about customers, such as names, account details, and contact information.
customer service concept
Customer service is the support an organization provides to help users or customers solve problems.
customer vaults concept
Customer vaults are secure storage areas where a service keeps customer secrets or sensitive data.

A Customizer preview is a WordPress feature that shows how a site would look with theme changes before those changes are published.

A CVE is a public identifier used to track a specific known software vulnerability.
also: CVEs
cyber concept
Cyber is a broad shorthand for things related to computers, networks, and digital security.
cyber insurance concept
Cyber insurance is insurance that helps cover costs from cyber incidents such as breaches, ransomware, or business disruption.
cyber resilience concept
Cyber resilience is an organization's ability to keep operating and recover quickly when cyberattacks or failures happen.
cyber threat intelligence concept
Cyber threat intelligence is information about attackers, their methods, and risks that helps organizations defend themselves.
cyberattack concept
A cyberattack is an attempt to damage, disrupt, or gain unauthorized access to computer systems or data.
cyberattacks concept
Malicious activities conducted over computer networks to steal data, disrupt operations, or damage systems.
cybercrime concept
Cybercrime is crime carried out using computers, networks, or the internet.
Cybersecurity concept
Cybersecurity is the practice of protecting computers, networks, software, and data from digital attacks or misuse.
cybersecurity companies organization
Cybersecurity companies are businesses that sell services or products to help protect computers, networks, and data.
cybersecurity vendors organization
Cybersecurity vendors are companies that sell products or services to help protect computers, networks, and data.
cybersecurity-and-infrastructure-security-agency organization
The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency is the U.S. government agency that helps defend critical infrastructure and improve cybersecurity.
Cybersole tool
Cybersole is an automated purchasing bot used to buy limited-release products online.
Dark web concept
The dark web is a part of the internet that requires special tools to access and is often discussed in relation to hidden marketplaces and forums.
dark web forums concept
Dark web forums are hidden online discussion sites that may be used to buy, sell, or discuss illegal goods and cybercrime services.
dark web leak site concept
A dark web leak site is a hidden website where criminals publish stolen data to pressure victims or advertise breaches.
also: the site, Cl0p ransomware site, Cl0p’s dark-web leak site
Data access concept
Data access means the ability to view, use, change, or retrieve information from a system.
data breach concept
A data breach is an incident where sensitive, private, or protected information is accessed, exposed, or stolen without permission.
data categories concept
Data categories are labels used to group information by type, sensitivity, source, or purpose.
data exfiltration technique
Data exfiltration is the unauthorized removal or copying of data from a system.
data exposure concept
Data exposure means sensitive information is left accessible to people or systems that should not be able to see it.
data exposure incident concept
A data exposure incident is an event where sensitive information becomes accessible to people who should not see it.
Data Flows concept
The paths data takes as it moves between people, applications, devices, and services.
data leaks concept
Data leaks are incidents where private or sensitive information is exposed to people who should not have access to it.
data misuse concept
Data misuse is using information in a way that is unauthorized, unfair, harmful, or outside what people expected.
Data protection concept
Data protection means keeping information safe from loss, theft, exposure, or unauthorized changes.
data protection authorities organization
Data protection authorities are government regulators that enforce privacy and personal-data protection laws.
Data Protection Commission organization
The Data Protection Commission is Ireland's authority for enforcing data-protection law.
also: DPC, Irish data protection authorities
Data Protection Commission (DPC) organization
The Data Protection Commission is Ireland's government authority for enforcing data-protection and privacy rules.
data residency concept
Data residency is the requirement or choice to store data in a specific country or region.
data security concept
Data security is the practice of protecting information from unauthorized access, theft, damage, or exposure.
data security platform product
A data security platform is software that helps organizations find, monitor, protect, and control access to sensitive data.
Data security posture management concept
Data security posture management helps organizations find where sensitive data lives, assess risks around it, and improve how it is protected.
Data sensitivity concept
Data sensitivity describes how carefully information must be protected based on the harm that could happen if it is exposed or changed.
also: government data
data theft concept
Data theft is the stealing of information from a system or service.
datacenter proxies concept
Datacenter proxies are proxy servers hosted in data centers rather than on home or mobile internet connections.

Dates of birth are personal information that can help identify someone and may be sensitive if exposed.
dcsync

debugging technique
Debugging is the process of finding and fixing problems in software code.
deception technique
Deception is tricking a person or system into believing something false, often to gain access or hide activity.
Decrypt technique
Decrypt is a cryptographic operation that turns encrypted data back into readable data when the correct key is used.
decryption concept
Decryption is the process of turning scrambled encrypted data back into readable information.
Deep PR Review tool
Deep PR Review is a code-review tool or feature that analyzes pull requests for issues in more depth.
defaced technique
Defaced means a website has been altered without permission, often to show an attacker’s message.
defacement technique
Defacement is when an attacker changes a website or screen to show unauthorized content.
default credentials concept
Default credentials are factory-set usernames and passwords that should be changed because attackers often know them.
defenders concept
Defenders are the people or teams responsible for protecting systems and responding to cyber threats.
deleted concept
Deleted means removed from normal access, though copies may sometimes still exist in backups, logs, or recovery areas.
Deloitte organization
Deloitte is a multinational professional-services company that provides consulting, audit, tax, and risk services.
Delphos Labs organization
Delphos Labs is a cybersecurity research organization.
also: Delphos
dependencies concept
Dependencies are outside software components that a project relies on to work.
dependency concept
A dependency is outside software that an application relies on, which can create risk if that outside component is vulnerable or malicious.

A detached signature is a digital signature stored separately from the data it verifies.
Detect technique
Detect means to identify suspicious or malicious activity in systems, networks, or data.
detection concept
Detection is the process of finding signs of suspicious or malicious activity.
Detection and Analysis concept
Detection and analysis is the incident-response phase where teams identify alerts and determine what happened.
detection engineering technique
Detection engineering is the work of creating, testing, and improving rules or logic that spot suspicious activity in systems.
also: Cloud detection engineering
detection engineers concept
Detection engineers create and tune security rules, analytics, and alerts that help organizations spot cyber threats.
detections concept
Alerts or findings generated by security tools indicating that a potential threat or malicious activity has been identified.
Device management concept
Device management is the work of setting up, maintaining, securing, and retiring an organization's computers and mobile devices.
Device Readiness concept
Device readiness means having a work computer or mobile device set up and ready for someone to use.
Device Restarts concept
Device restarts are times when a computer or mobile device shuts down and starts again.
DevOps concept
DevOps is a way of working where software development and IT operations teams collaborate to build, deploy, and run software faster.
digital currency concept
Digital currency is money or value that exists electronically rather than as physical cash.
Digital Employee Experience (DEX) concept
Digital Employee Experience, or DEX, measures how well employees can use their work devices, applications, and digital services.
digital wallets product
Digital wallets are apps or services that store payment information, cryptocurrency keys, or other digital assets.

A Linux kernel vulnerability (CVE-2022-0847) allowing local privilege escalation by overwriting sensitive read-only files.
DISALLOW_FILE_MODS concept
DISALLOW_FILE_MODS is a WordPress configuration setting that prevents changes such as installing, updating, or editing themes and plugins through the admin interface.
Disclosure concept
Disclosure is the act of reporting or publishing information about a security issue so it can be understood and fixed.
discord product
Discord is a communication platform for text, voice, and video chats, popular with gaming and online communities.
Discovery technique
Discovery is the attacker activity of learning about a victim’s systems, accounts, and network before taking further action.
disk encryption concept
Disk encryption protects data on a drive by scrambling it so it cannot be read without the right key or password.
disruption concept
Disruption is an interruption that prevents systems, services, or operations from working normally.
disruptive concept
Disruptive describes activity that interrupts normal use of a system, service, or business process.

DKIM is an email signing method that helps verify that a message was authorized by a domain and was not changed after signing.

A DLL is a Windows file that contains code other programs can load and use.

DLL sideloading is an attack where malware places a fake DLL where a trusted Windows program will load it.
dll-side-loading
DLL side-loading is when attackers trick a legitimate program into loading a malicious DLL file.

DNS-over-HTTPS protocol
DNS-over-HTTPS is a protocol that encrypts DNS lookups by sending them through HTTPS, making browsing requests harder to monitor or tamper with.
DOCTYPE protocol
DOCTYPE is an XML declaration that can define document rules and external resources, requiring careful security handling.
also: DOCTYPEs

A domain admin is a highly privileged account that can control many computers and users in a Windows domain.
also: domain admin-equivalent control, domain admin privileges, domain admin-level control, domain admin compromise
domain controller concept
A domain controller is a server that manages logins, permissions, and identity for a Windows network domain.
domain controllers product
Domain controllers are servers that manage logins, permissions, and security policies in a Windows domain.

Domain impersonation is a trick where attackers use lookalike domains to make emails or websites seem like they belong to a trusted organization.
Domain registration concept
Domain registration is the process of reserving an internet name, such as example.com, so it can be used for a website or email.
DotDataMonitor Pro product
DotDataMonitor Pro is a named product or service referenced in security reporting.
download page concept
A download page is a web page where users can obtain software, files, or updates.
DTD retrieval technique
DTD retrieval is the fetching of XML document definitions, which can be abused to make a server request unwanted resources.
also: SSRF
Duo Access Gateway product
Duo Access Gateway was an on-premises Duo Security product for providing single sign-on.
also: DAG, on-premises Access Gateway product
Duo Security organization
Duo Security is a cybersecurity company that provides identity and multi-factor authentication products.
ebtables SNAT tool
ebtables SNAT is Linux networking functionality that rewrites source address information for traffic passing through Ethernet bridges.
EC2 product
Amazon EC2 is Amazon Web Services’ cloud service for renting virtual servers.
also: EC2 instance
EDR product
EDR is security software that monitors computers and servers for suspicious activity and helps respond to attacks.
EDR tools tool
EDR tools are security products that monitor computers for suspicious behavior and help detect and respond to attacks.

An education platform is an online service used by schools, teachers, or students for learning-related work.
also: widely used education platform
elevated access concept
Elevated access means a user or program has higher-than-normal permissions, such as administrator rights.
email addresses concept
Email addresses are the unique names people use to send and receive email, such as user@example.com.
email authentication checks technique
Email authentication checks are tests such as SPF, DKIM, and DMARC that help verify whether an email really came from the domain it claims.
Email security concept
Email security protects inboxes and users from threats such as phishing, malware, and scam messages.
employers organization
Employers are people or organizations that hire workers and may hold sensitive employee information.
Encrypt technique
Encrypt is the process of turning readable data into scrambled data that only someone with the right key can read.
encrypted concept
Encrypted data has been scrambled so that only someone with the right key can read it.
encryption concept
Encryption is a way of scrambling information so only someone with the right key can read it.

Encryptionless extortion is ransomware-style pressure that threatens data release or disruption without necessarily encrypting files.
also: extortion-only incidents, extortion-only ransomware incidents
endpoint concept
An endpoint is a user device such as a laptop, phone, or server that connects to a network.
endpoint detection and response product
Endpoint detection and response is security software that watches computers and devices for suspicious activity and helps respond to threats.
endpoint management concept
Endpoint management is the practice of monitoring, configuring, and securing devices such as laptops, desktops, and phones.
endpoints concept
Endpoints are user-facing devices such as laptops, desktops, or phones that connect to systems and data.
enrichment technique
Enrichment adds extra context to raw security data, such as looking up an IP address, domain, or account to make it more useful.

Enrollment is the process of registering a device or user with an organization's management system.
enterprise security concept
Enterprise security is the protection of an organization's systems, data, users, and networks from cyber threats.
Enterprise security strategies concept
Enterprise security strategies are organization-wide plans for protecting systems, data, and users from threats.
also: Legacy tools, traditional enterprise security tools

Entity expansion is an XML feature that can be abused to consume excessive resources or alter processed content.
also: billion laughs

Entra SMS/Voice Policy Scanner PowerShell script tool

entra-id
Microsoft Entra ID is Microsoft’s cloud identity service, formerly called Azure Active Directory.
entry point concept
An entry point is the place or method an attacker, program, or process first uses to get into a system or workflow.
entry points concept
Entry points are the places where attackers can first get into a system or network.
Enveloped signature technique
An enveloped signature is a digital signature placed inside the XML document that it signs.
also: Enveloped signatures
Environmental Protection Agency organization
The Environmental Protection Agency is the U.S. federal agency responsible for environmental protection, including oversight related to water infrastructure.
EPA organization
EPA is the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, a federal agency that oversees environmental protection and related infrastructure issues.
escaping technique
Escaping means changing special characters in text so a computer treats them as normal text instead of as commands or code.
espionage concept
Espionage is spying to gather information without permission.
ESXi product
ESXi is VMware's bare-metal hypervisor used to run virtual machines on servers.
also: ESXi hosts, hypervisors

EtherHiding is a technique where attackers hide malicious code or instructions in blockchain smart contracts.
European consumer groups organization
European consumer groups are organizations that represent consumers' interests across European countries.
European consumer rights groups organization
European consumer rights groups are organizations that advocate for consumers' privacy, safety, and fair treatment.
european-union
The European Union is a political and economic union of European countries that also creates cybersecurity and privacy rules.
also: EU

Event Tracing for Windows is a Windows logging and tracing system used to collect detailed information about system and application activity.
also: ETW

Event Viewer is a Windows tool for viewing system, application, and security logs.
evidence collection technique
Evidence collection is the process of gathering logs, files, screenshots, and other proof for an investigation or audit.

Excel is Microsoft’s spreadsheet application for organizing and analyzing data.
Excel 2016 product
Excel 2016 is a version of Microsoft Excel, a spreadsheet application.
Excel 2024 product
A desktop version of Microsoft's Excel spreadsheet program released in 2024.
Excel Online product
The web-browser version of Microsoft Excel.
excessive permissions vulnerability
Excessive permissions are access rights that are broader than a person, app, or token actually needs.
Excessive privilege concept
Giving a user or program more access than it needs to do its job.
Excessive privileges concept
Excessive privileges mean an account or program has more access rights than it actually needs.
Exclusions concept
Exclusions are security-tool exceptions that tell software not to scan or block certain files, folders, or processes.
EXE other
A file extension on Windows that runs an executable program, commonly used to install software but also to deliver malware.
executable concept
